title: Alistair Croll (co-author, Lean Analytics) has given away at least a dozen copies — 'an incredibly important reset for startups and capitalism itself'
summary: Alistair Croll, who co-wrote Lean Analytics in the Lean Series and runs the FWD50 conference, posts a photo of three more copies going out to friends and says he has handed out at least a dozen since publication. His framing pairs the serious claim with the unserious one: an important reset, and a fun read.
blockquote: 3 more copies of Eric Ries amazing book going out to friends. I’ve given at least a dozen of these to people since it came out. It isn’t just an incredibly important reset for startups and capitalism itself—it’s a really fun read.
